highlights: Spread markets: where Boros lists one, a single Boros order hedges your Hyperliquid/Gate pair
Orders never stop on low Boros gas: the top-up comes from your best-funded coin when the traded one can't spare it
ETH and BTC coin books show "Hedged" only when the legs match within 0.1%
The Pairs tab is now "Fixed Rate Pairs". A spread and single legs show as separate pairs, so you can compare and close them apart
